subject: Speed to lead: the #1 revenue unlock for studios
html:
Hey {{first_name}},


Most fitness studios lose leads not because their offer is weak — but because they respond too slowly. The average studio follows up 27+ hours after a lead opts in. By then, that person has already booked somewhere else.


Here's what speed to lead looks like in practice: responding within 5 minutes of a lead coming in increases conversion by up to 21x versus a 30-minute delay. AI makes this possible without anyone on your team manually following up.


The setup is simpler than it sounds: when someone fills out a form or clicks an ad, an AI-triggered SMS fires in under 60 seconds — specific to what they inquired about, with a direct booking link. No waiting. No leads going cold overnight.


Studios running this see a 2–3x lift in booked consultations from the same ad spend — just by fixing the response window. Same leads, faster follow-up, more clients.
